items.exampleEn: Her intention was to help, not to cause trouble.
items.exampleZh: 她的本意是幫忙，不是添麻煩。

items.exampleEn: She walks at a fast pace.
The power was restored after two hours.
A chance to travel abroad may arise next year.
items.exampleZh: 明年可能會出現出國旅行的機會。

items.exampleEn: Our seats on the plane were assigned by the airline.
items.exampleZh: 我們在飛機上的座位是航空公司分配的。

items.exampleEn: Cats react quickly to sudden sounds.
items.exampleZh: 貓對突然的聲音反應很快。

items.exampleEn: After a short break, the meeting proceeded.
items.exampleZh: 短暫休息後，會議繼續進行。

items.exampleEn: Many difficulties had to be overcome to build the bridge.
items.exampleZh: 為了蓋這座橋，必須克服許多困難。

items.sentenceEn: Everyone learns at their own pace.
items.sentenceZh: 每個人都用自己的步調學習。

items.audioEn: Please proceed to Gate 5. Your flight is now boarding.
items.audioZh: 請前往 5 號登機門，您的班機正在登機。

items.sentenceEn: A question arose during the meeting.
items.sentenceZh: 會議中出現了一個問題。

items.sentenceEn: A good night's sleep can restore your strength.
items.sentenceZh: 一夜好眠能恢復你的體力。

items.stemEn: With hard work, she was able to ____ her fear of water.
items.stemZh: 靠著努力，她克服了對水的恐懼。

items.stemEn: How did your parents ____ when they heard the news?
items.stemZh: 你爸媽聽到這個消息時有什麼反應？

items.passageEn: For a school contest, our team had to restore an old boat in two weeks. The teacher assigned each of us a different job. At first, we worked at a slow pace, and problems soon arose: the wood was too wet, and some parts were missing. Nobody knew how to react. But our intention was to finish on time, and there was no time to waste. We overcame the problems one by one. After a short meeting, we got back to work. In the end, we finished on time, and our boat floated perfectly!
items.passageZh: 為了一場學校比賽，我們隊必須在兩週內修復一艘舊船。老師分配給我們每個人不同的工作。一開始我們進度很慢，很快就出現了問題：木頭太濕了，還少了一些零件。沒有人知道該怎麼反應。但我們的本意是準時完成，沒有時間可以浪費。我們一個一個克服了問題。開了個短會後，我們又回去工作。最後，我們準時完成，船也浮得很好！

questions.questionZh: 一開始出現了什麼問題？
options: 老師臨時改了比賽規則
準時完成，船也浮得很好

items.promptZh: 我沒有要傷害任何人的意思。
referenceEn: I had no intention of hurting anyone.
I didn't have any intention of hurting anyone.
rubricZh: intention 表示「意圖、打算」，例如 have no intention of… 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 overcome 造一個句子，說說你克服過或想克服的困難。
referenceEn: I overcame my fear of speaking in public.
I want to overcome my fear of dogs.
rubricZh: overcome 表示「克服」，例如 overcome a fear 等說法
說的是自己的經驗或想法（例如 I）
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）
